business_summary: Narragansett Bancorp, Inc. operates as a bank holding company that provides various banking and financial services to individuals and businesses in the United States. The company offers personal checking services, such as Active, Direct, Free, Preferred, Senior/Minor, Compare checking accounts, and Honor Checking and Veteran Banking services; savings services, including statement savings, savings club, certificates of deposit, money market accounts, and investing; lending services, including personal loans, mortgage loans, manufactured and mobile homes, home equity lines of credit, home equity loans, home improvement loans, HEAT loans, auto loans, and online loan payments; and online banking services, such as mobile banking, eStatements, purchase rewards, money management, and easy money transfers. It also offers ATM/debit cards, bounce protection, credit cards, interactive teller machines, safe deposit boxes, foreign currency exchange, and insurance services. Additionally, it offers business checking services, such as Free Business Checking, Business Analysis Checking, Right Fit Checking, Municipal/Non-Profit Checking, and Compare checking accounts; business savings plans, including statement savings, business money market access, certificates of deposit, retirement plans, business IRAs, and Plimoth Investment; and lending services, such as commercial lending, Providence Lending Office, business lines and loans, small business lending, business development partnerships, Invest MA, and online loan payments. The company was incorporated in 2026 and is based in Swansea, Massachusetts.
business_summary_ko: Narragansett Bancorp, Inc.는 미국의 개인 및 기업에 다양한 은행 및 금융 서비스를 제공하는 은행 지주 회사로 운영됩니다. 회사는 Active, Direct, Free, Preferred, Senior/Minor, 당좌 예금 계좌 비교, Honor Checking 및 Veteran Banking 서비스와 같은 개인 당좌 서비스를 제공합니다. 명세서 저축, 저축 클럽, 예금 증서, 머니 마켓 계좌 및 투자를 포함한 저축 서비스; 개인 대출, 모기지 대출, 제조 및 이동식 주택, 주택 담보 신용 한도, 주택 담보 대출, 주택 개조 대출, HEAT 대출, 자동차 대출 및 온라인 대출 지불을 포함한 대출 서비스; 모바일 뱅킹, e-스테이트먼트, 구매 보상, 자금 관리, 간편한 자금 이체 등의 온라인 뱅킹 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한 ATM/직불 카드, 반송 보호, 신용 카드, 대화형 입출금기, 안전 금고, 외화 환전 및 보험 서비스도 제공합니다. 또한 무료 비즈니스 체킹(Free Business Checking), 비즈니스 분석 체킹(Business Analysis Checking), 적합한 체킹(Right Fit Checking), 지방자치단체/비영리 체킹(Municipal/Non-Profit Checking) 및 체킹 계좌 비교와 같은 비즈니스 체킹 서비스를 제공합니다. 비즈니스 저축 계획에는 다음이 포함됩니다.
